input.quote: d. Use of Credit Data during the term of this Agreement. Client hereby grants to TrueLink the nonexclusive worldwide right and license to use, distribute, disseminate, license, resell, exploit, upload, display, copy and store Credit Data subject to the limitations set forth in and in accordance with the Non-Competition Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant binding Mortgage Logic.com (Client). Searches for "solicit", "employ", "hire", "induce", "personnel" and "recruit" return only an unsolicited commercial e-mail provision (§ 7) and routine references to employees in the access-restriction (§ 8(c)) and indemnity (§ 12) clauses — none of which restrict either party from hiring or soliciting the other's staff. The Client covenants section (§ 8) and confidentiality section (§ 10) were read in full and contain no personnel restriction; the only restrictive-covenant reference is to a separate Non-Competition Agreement, and it limits use of Credit Data rather than hiring of personnel. This matches the preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer), so no redline is required.
